0.a: Voyola is a travel and services app designed to simplify the airport experience on a single digital platform. It brings together participating food and beverage locations, selected premium airport services, a payment experience and Voyola benefits in one place.

1.a: Voyola is intended for travellers using a compatible mobile device or web browser in supported markets and service locations. Terms of use may vary for some services.

2.q: Which airport can I use Voyola at?
2.a: The Voyola experience is being developed with a focus on the Istanbul Airport ecosystem. Current participating locations and services will be shown in the app.

3.q: Which services can I access with Voyola?
3.a: The initial scope will include participating food and beverage locations and selected premium services such as Lounge, Fast Track and Buggy. The scope will expand over time.

4.a: You can use the payment options offered through Voyola at supported locations and transaction types. Available methods are shown during the transaction.

5.a: Voyola-only benefits may be offered on eligible campaigns and transactions. Campaign terms, earning and redemption details are shown on the relevant offer screen.

6.q: Do I need an account to use the app?
6.a: You can browse Voyola without creating a new account; for features such as purchases, payments, personalisation or benefits you can easily continue from there.

7.a: When you grant location permission, Voyola may use location data to show nearby services and relevant suggestions. Details are explained in the Privacy Policy.

8.q: How is my personal data protected?
8.a: Voyola applies processes and technical/organisational controls in line with applicable legislation on the processing of personal data. Details are provided in the Privacy Notice and Privacy Policy.

9.q: How can I get support if I have a problem?
9.a: You can create a support request from the Help/Support area in the app or through the current contact channels listed on the website.
